notes: Schemas and complete descriptions come from local MCP initialize/tools/list using the upstream server and installed SDK. No business tool was invoked; META_* environment variables were removed. Some structured Meta payloads are exposed upstream as JSON strings; schemas preserve that design. Auth and business-management tools are supporting; all registered tools are included.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns in the ad account. Supports filtering by status and objective. Returns paginated results.

status.description: Filter by status: ACTIVE, PAUSED, DELETED, ARCHIVED

objective.description: Filter by objective: OUTCOME_AWARENESS, OUTCOME_ENGAGEMENT, OUTCOME_LEADS, OUTCOME_SALES, OUTCOME_TRAFFIC, OUTCOME_APP_PROMOTION

account_id.description: Ad account ID to query (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

tools.name: get_campaign
tools.description: Get details of a specific campaign by ID.

tools.name: create_campaign
tools.description: Create a new ad campaign. Defaults to PAUSED status. Requires name and objective. Budget can be set at campaign or ad set level.

daily_budget.description: Daily budget in account currency cents (e.g. '5000' = $50.00)

lifetime_budget.description: Lifetime budget in account currency cents

special_ad_categories.description: JSON array of special ad categories: HOUSING, EMPLOYMENT, FINANCIAL_PRODUCTS_SERVICES, ISSUES_ELECTIONS_POLITICS, NONE. This field is required by Meta on every campaign — pass '[]' or '["NONE"]' if none apply. CREDIT was renamed to FINANCIAL_PRODUCTS_SERVICES; the old name is no longer accepted.

special_ad_category_country.description: JSON array of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes, e.g. '["US"]'. Required for ISSUES_ELECTIONS_POLITICS (which also requires authorization to run ads in those countries). For HOUSING, EMPLOYMENT, and FINANCIAL_PRODUCTS_SERVICES it is optional and defaults to the ad account's listed tax country if omitted.

bid_strategy.description: Bid strategy: LOWEST_COST_WITHOUT_CAP, LOWEST_COST_WITH_BID_CAP, COST_CAP, LOWEST_COST_WITH_MIN_ROAS. Meta defaults new campaigns to LOWEST_COST_WITH_BID_CAP, which requires a bid_amount on every ad set — pass LOWEST_COST_WITHOUT_CAP to avoid that.

spend_cap.description: Lifetime spend cap for the campaign, in account currency cents. Once set it cannot be removed, only raised or reset — pass '0' to reset/clear it.

is_adset_budget_sharing_enabled.description: Whether ad sets under this campaign can share budget with each other. Required on some newer ad accounts — omitting it can cause campaign creation to fail with 'Must specify True or False in is_adset_budget_sharing_enabled'.

account_id.description: Ad account ID to create the campaign in (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

tools.name: update_campaign
tools.description: Update an existing campaign. Only provided fields will be modified.

status.description: New status: ACTIVE, PAUSED, DELETED, ARCHIVED

daily_budget.description: New daily budget in currency cents

lifetime_budget.description: New lifetime budget in currency cents

bid_strategy.description: New bid strategy: LOWEST_COST_WITHOUT_CAP, LOWEST_COST_WITH_BID_CAP, COST_CAP, LOWEST_COST_WITH_MIN_ROAS

spend_cap.description: Lifetime spend cap for the campaign, in account currency cents. Once set it cannot be removed, only raised or reset — pass '0' to reset/clear it.

tools.description: Create a new ad set. Requires name, campaign_id, budget, optimization_goal, billing_event, and targeting. Defaults to PAUSED status.

optimization_goal.description: Optimization goal: NONE, APP_INSTALLS, AD_RECALL_LIFT, ENGAGED_USERS, EVENT_RESPONSES, IMPRESSIONS, LEAD_GENERATION, QUALITY_LEAD, LINK_CLICKS, OFFSITE_CONVERSIONS, PAGE_LIKES, POST_ENGAGEMENT, QUALITY_CALL, REACH, LANDING_PAGE_VIEWS, VISIT_INSTAGRAM_PROFILE, ENGAGED_PAGE_VIEWS, VALUE, THRUPLAY, DERIVED_EVENTS, APP_INSTALLS_AND_OFFSITE_CONVERSIONS, CONVERSATIONS, IN_APP_VALUE, MESSAGING_PURCHASE_CONVERSION, MESSAGING_DEEP_CONVERSATION_AND_FOLLOW, SUBSCRIBERS, REMINDERS_SET, MEANINGFUL_CALL_ATTEMPT, PROFILE_VISIT, PROFILE_AND_PAGE_ENGAGEMENT, ADVERTISER_SILOED_VALUE, AUTOMATIC_OBJECTIVE, MESSAGING_APPOINTMENT_CONVERSION

billing_event.description: Billing event: APP_INSTALLS, CLICKS, IMPRESSIONS, LINK_CLICKS, NONE, OFFER_CLAIMS, PAGE_LIKES, POST_ENGAGEMENT, THRUPLAY, PURCHASE, LISTING_INTERACTION

bid_strategy.description: Bid strategy: LOWEST_COST_WITHOUT_CAP, LOWEST_COST_WITH_BID_CAP, COST_CAP, LOWEST_COST_WITH_MIN_ROAS

targeting.description: JSON string of targeting spec (age_min, age_max, genders, geo_locations, interests, etc.). Advantage+ Audience automation and other flags go inside this object too, e.g. targeting_automation: {"advantage_audience":1}. As of v26.0, ad sets in the Housing, Employment, or Financial Products and Services (HEC-F) special ad categories with relaxable (non-broad) targeting must explicitly set targeting.targeting_automation.advantage_audience to 1 or 0 — omitting it now returns ADS_TARGETING__REQUIRE_EXPLICIT_ADVANTAGE_AUDIENCE_FLAG. Not required for broad/default audience setups. Also note: as of Marketing API v26.0, the Instagram Explore Feed placement was removed (explicitly specifying it in publisher_platforms/instagram_positions now returns an error) and the 'story' value in messenger_positions is silently dropped.

promoted_object.description: JSON string of the promoted_object spec. Required for many objectives, e.g. OUTCOME_SALES needs {"pixel_id":"...","custom_event_type":"PURCHASE"}, OUTCOME_APP_PROMOTION needs {"application_id":"...","object_store_url":"..."}, OUTCOME_ENGAGEMENT page-like ads need {"page_id":"..."}. Omitting it when the objective requires one causes ad set creation to fail.

account_id.description: Ad account ID to create the ad set in (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

targeting.description: New targeting spec as JSON string. Advantage+ Audience automation flags go inside this object, e.g. targeting_automation: {"advantage_audience":1} — required for HEC-F (Housing/Employment/Financial Products and Services) ad sets with relaxable, non-broad targeting as of v26.0. Note: the Instagram Explore Feed placement was removed in Marketing API v26.0 — requests that explicitly include it now return an error.

bid_amount.description: New bid amount in currency cents

availability.description: Product availability: in stock, out of stock, etc.

tools.name: batch_products
tools.description: Batch create, update, or delete products in a catalog. Supports up to 5,000 items per request. Update operations support upsert.

requests.description: JSON array of batch requests. Each: {method: 'CREATE'|'UPDATE'|'DELETE', retailer_id: string, data?: {name, description, price, url, image_url, availability, ...}}

allow_upsert.description: Allow UPDATE to create items if they don't exist (default false)

tools.name: get_batch_status
tools.description: Check the status of a catalog batch operation.

tools.name: list_feeds
tools.description: List product feeds for a catalog.

tools.name: create_feed
tools.description: Create a new product feed for a catalog.

schedule.description: JSON string for feed schedule configuration

tools.name: upload_feed
tools.description: Upload/trigger a feed file upload for a product feed.

url.description: URL of the feed file to upload

tools.name: get_feed_uploads
tools.description: Get upload history for a product feed.

tools.name: list_rules
tools.description: List automated rules for the ad account.

account_id.description: Ad account ID to query (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

tools.name: get_rule
tools.description: Get details of a specific automated rule.

tools.name: create_rule
tools.description: Create a new automated rule for the ad account.

account_id.description: Ad account ID to create the rule in (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

tools.name: update_rule
tools.description: Update an existing automated rule.

evaluation_spec.description: JSON string defining updated rule conditions

execution_spec.description: JSON string defining updated rule actions

schedule_spec.description: JSON string defining updated rule schedule

tools.name: delete_rule
tools.description: Delete an automated rule.

tools.name: list_experiments
tools.description: List A/B test experiments (ad studies) for the ad account.

account_id.description: Ad account ID to query (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

tools.name: create_experiment
tools.description: Create a new A/B test experiment (ad study).

start_time.description: Start time in ISO 8601 or Unix timestamp

end_time.description: End time in ISO 8601 or Unix timestamp

cells.description: JSON array of test cells: [{name, campaign_id}]

account_id.description: Ad account ID to create the experiment in (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

tools.name: get_experiment
tools.description: Get details of a specific experiment (ad study).

tools.name: update_experiment
tools.description: Update an existing experiment (ad study).

tools.name: get_experiment_results
tools.description: Get results/cells of an experiment (ad study).

tools.name: send_conversion_event
tools.description: Send a server-side conversion event via the Conversions API (pixel).

events.description: JSON array of events: [{event_name, event_time, user_data, custom_data, action_source}]

test_event_code.description: Events Manager test code; use to verify delivery as test events

tools.name: send_offline_event
tools.description: Send offline conversion events through the Conversions API to a dataset. Store events must use action_source=physical_store.

event_set_id.description: Dataset ID for offline events (legacy parameter name retained)

test_event_code.description: Events Manager test code; use to verify delivery as test events

tools.name: list_offline_event_sets
tools.description: List offline conversion data sets for the ad account.

account_id.description: Ad account ID to query (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

tools.name: create_offline_event_set
tools.description: Create a new offline conversion data set.

account_id.description: Ad account ID to create the event set in (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

tools.name: list_budget_schedules
tools.description: List budget schedules attached to a campaign or ad set. Returns paginated results.

parent_id.description: Campaign or ad set ID that owns the budget schedules

tools.name: create_budget_schedule
tools.description: Create a budget schedule on a campaign or ad set.

parent_id.description: Campaign or ad set ID that will own the budget schedule

budget_value.description: Unsigned value interpreted according to budget_value_type (ABSOLUTE uses currency minor units)

time_start.description: Schedule start time as a Unix timestamp

time_end.description: Schedule end time as a Unix timestamp

tools.name: update_budget_schedule
tools.description: Update an existing budget schedule. Only provided fields will be modified.

budget_value.description: New unsigned value interpreted according to budget_value_type

time_start.description: New start time as a Unix timestamp

time_end.description: New end time as a Unix timestamp

tools.name: delete_budget_schedule
tools.description: Delete a budget schedule. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: list_rf_predictions
tools.description: List reach & frequency predictions for the ad account. Returns paginated results.

account_id.description: Ad account ID to query (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

tools.name: create_rf_prediction
tools.description: Create a new reach & frequency prediction. Provide targeting spec as JSON string, budget in cents, and scheduling info.

start_time.description: Prediction start time (ISO 8601 or Unix timestamp)

stop_time.description: Prediction stop time (ISO 8601 or Unix timestamp)

account_id.description: Ad account ID to create the prediction in (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

tools.name: get_rf_prediction
tools.description: Get details of a specific reach & frequency prediction by ID.

tools.name: delete_rf_prediction
tools.description: Delete a reach & frequency prediction. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: list_block_lists
tools.description: List publisher block lists for the ad account. Returns paginated results.

account_id.description: Ad account ID to query (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

tools.name: create_block_list
tools.description: Create a new publisher block list for the ad account.

account_id.description: Ad account ID to create the block list in (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

tools.name: add_to_block_list
tools.description: Add publisher URLs to an existing block list.

urls.description: JSON array of URLs to block (e.g. '["example.com","bad-site.com"]')

tools.name: remove_from_block_list
tools.description: Remove publisher URLs from an existing block list.

urls.description: JSON array of URLs to remove (e.g. '["example.com"]')

tools.name: delete_block_list
tools.description: Delete a publisher block list. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: get_ad_account
tools.description: Get details of the configured ad account including status, balance, currency, timezone, and spend info.

account_id.description: Ad account ID to query (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

tools.name: list_ad_accounts
tools.description: List all ad accounts accessible by the current user. Returns paginated results.

tools.name: update_ad_account
tools.description: Update the configured ad account settings. Only provided fields will be modified.

spend_cap.description: Account spend cap in currency cents (e.g. '100000' = $1000.00)

account_id.description: Ad account ID to update (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

tools.name: get_account_activities
tools.description: Get activity log for the ad account. Shows changes made to campaigns, ad sets, ads, etc.

account_id.description: Ad account ID to query (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

tools.name: list_account_users
tools.description: List users who have access to the ad account with their roles and permissions.

account_id.description: Ad account ID to query (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

tools.name: list_businesses
tools.description: List all businesses accessible by the current user. Returns paginated results.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Get details of a specific business by ID.

tools.name: list_business_ad_accounts
tools.description: List ad accounts owned by the configured business. Requires META_BUSINESS_ID env var.

tools.name: list_business_users
tools.description: List users of the configured business. Requires META_BUSINESS_ID env var.

tools.name: add_business_user
tools.description: Add a user to the configured business by email. Requires META_BUSINESS_ID env var.

email.description: Email address of the user to add

tools.name: remove_business_user
tools.description: Remove a user from the configured business. Requires META_BUSINESS_ID env var.

user_id.description: User ID to remove from the business

tools.name: list_business_pages
tools.description: List Facebook Pages owned by the configured business. Requires META_BUSINESS_ID env var.

tools.name: list_business_instagram_accounts
tools.description: List Instagram accounts owned by the configured business. Requires META_BUSINESS_ID env var.

tools.name: list_system_users
tools.description: List system users of the configured business. Requires META_BUSINESS_ID env var.

tools.name: create_system_user
tools.description: Create a new system user in the configured business. Requires META_BUSINESS_ID env var.

tools.name: exchange_token
tools.description: Exchange a short-lived access token for a long-lived token. Requires META_APP_ID and META_APP_SECRET to be configured.

tools.name: refresh_token
tools.description: Extend a valid long-lived user access token through Meta's documented token exchange flow. Requires META_APP_ID and META_APP_SECRET.

tools.name: debug_token
tools.description: Debug an access token to inspect its properties, permissions, expiration, and validity. Requires META_APP_ID and META_APP_SECRET.

tools.name: search_ad_library
tools.description: Search the Meta Ad Library for ads. Allows searching by keywords, countries, and ad type. Useful for competitive research and transparency.

search_terms.description: Keywords to search for in ads

ad_reached_countries.description: Comma-separated country codes where ads were shown (e.g. 'US,GB,KR')

ad_type.description: Ad type filter: ALL, POLITICAL_AND_ISSUE_ADS, HOUSING_ADS, etc.
